module.watermark.desc: 纯文字水印，支持平面或立体倾斜／厚度，全局字体同步，可调文字、大小、位置和颜色
Text-only watermark with flat or extruded tilted appearance, global fonts, adjustable text, size, position and color
module.selfname.desc: 在自己头顶显示随人物移动的名字，默认第三人称，可调大小、高度和范围；仅自己客户端显示
Display a local overhead name following your player, normally in third person, with size, height and range controls
setting.selfname.customName: 自定义名字（留空使用实际名字）
ui.aip.languageHint: 建议选择与语音包训练语言一致的语言；自动模式保留语音页的语言设置
Choose a language matching the voice pack training language; Auto keeps the voice-page language
mode.swim_authorized: 单人同步／多人本地姿态
module.swimstate.desc: 自动切换游泳姿态；单人真实同步，多人只改本地显示，不发送配套指令
Automatically use a swimming pose: synchronized in singleplayer and local appearance in multiplayer, without companion commands
module.antikick.desc: 真实空闲跳动与下降脉冲，可调间隔和幅度；不阻止封禁、服务器断开或网络超时
Real idle jumps and downward pulses with adjustable interval and depth; does not block bans, disconnects or network timeouts
setting.cheststealer.lootMode.hint: 只拿战备物资、指定武器、按配额补齐指定物品，或明确选择全部。
Take combat supplies, exact weapon IDs, listed item quotas, or explicitly choose everything.
setting.cheststealer.weaponIds.hint: 逗号分隔精确物品 ID，例如 diamond_sword, bow；清空后不拿任何武器。
Exact comma-separated IDs, e.g. diamond_sword, bow. An empty list takes no weapons.
setting.cheststealer.itemQuotas.hint: 例如 arrow=64, golden_carrot=32；按自己已有总量补齐，包含装备与副手。
Example: arrow=64, golden_carrot=32. Tops up the amount already owned, including equipment and offhand.
setting.cheststealer.junkAction.hint: 按整理规则处理背包杂物；放回当前真实打开的箱子、直接丢弃或保留。
Apply cleaning rules to backpack junk: return to the real open container, drop, or keep.
setting.invcleaner.junkAction.hint: 独开可丢弃、保留，或等真实箱子打开后放回；自动拿取开启时遵从其杂物设置。
When used alone, drop, keep, or wait for a real open container to return junk. ChestStealer's junk action overrides this while enabled.
inventory.combatCycleHint: 三项同开时先穿装，再连续操作真实箱子；拿取和杂物动作以自动拿取的配置为准，默认按现有战备规则筛选。放回不会改为丢弃，保留不会被后台整理删除；锁定物品和农场种子仍受保护。

With all three enabled, equip first and operate real containers in order. ChestStealer controls loot and junk actions, using existing combat rules by default. Return never falls back to drop; Keep prevents background cleaning. Protected slots/items and farm seeds remain safe.
module.cheststealer.desc: 从真实打开的箱子按战备规则、指定武器 ID、物品数量配额或全部模式拿取；杂物可放回当前箱子、丢弃或保留，完成当前箱子后再换箱。

Loot real opened containers using combat rules, exact weapon IDs, item quotas, or Everything. Return backpack junk to the open container, drop, or keep it, and finish each container before opening the next.
module.invcleaner.desc: 默认保留武器、建筑方块、食物与战斗补给，也可用原杂物名单；独开可丢弃、保留或等真实箱子打开后放回。自动拿取开启时统一遵从其杂物动作。
Keep combat supplies by default or use the original junk list. Drop, keep, or wait for a real open container to return junk. While ChestStealer is enabled, follow its junk action.
module.teleportaura.desc: 输入已加载玩家的名字或 UUID，一次接近、跟随或环绕；仅尝试普通位置移动，不攻击。服务端可拒绝任何步长或速度，收到纠正后退避。Tab 名单不包含坐标。

Approach, follow or orbit a loaded player by name or UUID using ordinary position movement; never attacks. Servers may reject any step or speed and corrections trigger backoff. Tab entries contain no coordinates.
ui.teleportaura.help: 移动实验不保证服务器接受；高速度和大步长更容易被纠正。不会攻击或使用 /tp，原版位置纠正与确认保持生效。
Position experiments do not guarantee server acceptance. High speeds and large steps are more likely to be corrected. No attacks or /tp; vanilla corrections and acknowledgments remain active.
ui.teleportaura.helpCoordinates: 仅定位当前客户端已经加载的玩家实体；只有 Tab 名单条目的玩家坐标未知。
Targets must already exist as loaded player entities. Coordinates are unknown for players listed only in Tab.
ui.teleportaura.helpPreview: 青色：下一步检查通过；红色：下一步受阻；灰色：尚未检查的后续路线与落脚位置。最多预览 64 步，预览不等于服务端接受。
Cyan: next step checked. Red: next step blocked. Gray: later planned steps and landing. Up to 64 steps are shown; a preview does not prove server acceptance.
ui.teleportaura.unknownCoordinates: 仅 Tab 可见：坐标未知
ui.teleportaura.paused: 界面 / 移动控制冲突：暂停
ui.teleportaura.stopped: 纠正达到阈值：请重开以重试
Correction limit reached: re-enable to retry
ui.teleportaura.noLanding: 没有已加载的安全落脚点
ui.teleportaura.blocked: 下一步被碰撞 / 护边阻止
Next step blocked by collision / edge guard
ui.teleportaura.attempting: 尝试位置移动，服务端接受未知
ui.teleportaura.alreadyNear: 已在目标附近，未提交移动
Already near target; no movement submitted
ui.teleportaura.localArrival: 本地到达尝试位置，服务端接受未知
Local arrival at attempted position; acceptance unknown
setting.orexray.backfillPreview: 候选 / 待确认可视化
ui.orebackfill.counts: 已确认回填 {0} · 待确认 {1} · 候选 {2} · 拒绝/超时 {3}
ui.orebackfill.invalidId: 回填 ID 无效或不是安全实体方块
Invalid backfill ID or unsuitable solid block
ui.orebackfill.noMaterial: 缺少匹配的真实背包材料
ui.orebackfill.help: 默认关闭。只回填实际走过的身后空气；避开玩家、实体与前方出口，并使用真实背包材料和可达支撑面。青色为候选，橙色为等待服务端更新；只有收到服务端方块更新才计入已回填。

Off by default. Fills air behind the actual walked trail, keeping the player, entities and forward exit clear. Uses real inventory materials and reachable supporting faces. Cyan means candidate; orange means awaiting a server block update. Only server updates count as confirmed.
ui.orebackfill.matchHelp: 优先使用相同石料；石头 / 深板岩缺货时可使用圆石 / 深板岩圆石。指定材料仅接受背包中的安全实心方块。
Prefers matching terrain. Stone / deepslate can fall back to cobblestone / cobbled deepslate. Explicit materials must be safe solid blocks present in your inventory.
